articles.translatedExcerpt: Keisuke Kuwata has announced that the ``Keisuke Kuwata Lyrics Collection,'' which he has personally selected and compiled from the lyrics he has written during his 48-year career, will be released simultaneously by Kodansha in two volumes on December 16, 2026. In this book, Keisuke Kuwata personally selects the lyrics of the songs he has written over his 48-year career, and categorizes them into 40 themes that form Kuwata's world of lyrics. The recorded content covers not only Southern All Stars' songs, but also solo works and even songs provided to other artists, transcending the boundaries of groups and solos, and the number of songs exceeds 400. It is said that it is a content that can be called a permanent preservation version, giving a panoramic view of the lyric writing trajectory and lyric world of a single songwriter named Keisuke Kuwata. A lot of attention has been paid to the binding of the books, including A4 size hardcovers, dictionaries and picture books.
